hints.title: Stability Threshold Formulation
hints.text: Notice that feasibility is monotonic; if stability threshold S is reachable, any smaller threshold is also achievable.

hints.title: Disjoint Set Connectivity Test
hints.text: For a candidate threshold S, prioritize un-upgraded edges with weight at least S, then greedily admit upgraded candidates.

hints.title: Budget Verification
hints.text: Verify whether the entire graph connects into a single component without exceeding the upgrade budget k.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search on threshold stability with disjoint set union connectivity checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all subsets of upgraded edges combinatorially explodes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Parent array of size N tracks components with near-constant time operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize monotonicity, binary search on the minimum spanning tree stability, and check connectivity using disjoint set union.
